## Context and confirmed RCA

Gerrit Verify run 31874837464 completed in 29m11s with macOS at 27m38s. macOS spent 20.88s in test_hook_falls_back_to_git_when_env_unset, 16.38s setting up build-provenance artifacts, 10.69s rebuilding from sdist, plus 8.98s in a blank-env build. Ubuntu repeats these builds in three Python cells. Local profiling showed the fallback exports the 3,019-file / 42.4MB checkout although hatch_build.py resolves one SHA then writes src/rebar/_build_info.py: git add costs 1.37-1.53s; python -m build costs 3.85-4.32s. A same-hook minimal package preserved the exact SHA while reducing paired totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s.

The exact -n 3 --dist worksteal selector proved built_artifacts initializes on three workers, each paying 6.60-6.74s setup. This is a bounded contributor, not the cause of multi-minute host variation. The pre-repair selected-six serial baseline is 18.23s.

Live run 31874837464 received patchset 9aecb53e and checked it out, but artifact-probe built with trusted-main GITHUB_SHA 7d908fb. Truthiness-only probes accepted the wrong nonempty COMMIT, violating ducal-statuelike-ladybird exact-source identity.

## Ticket and OSS research

No prior rejection exists. ducal-statuelike-ladybird requires real sdist/wheel exact provenance. square-tragic-llama accepts a minimal Git fixture retaining exact fallback SHA plus shallow-source control. despotic-dorsal-greatdane approves immutable artifact reuse but stops at per-worker scope. cryptic-damp-panda identifies repeated package builds as coverage-neutral residual work.

Four popular active projects use this placement: pytest 68308aa has one Ubuntu package job before its matrix; pip f399c371 has packaging jobs outside Unix/Python tests; Poetry 92b74dc has one Ubuntu build/install smoke job outside its OS/Python matrix; Pydantic 02c5c975 has a dedicated Ubuntu distribution build outside its matrix. This is 4/4 consensus for one full-package integration job plus lighter behavioral probes in the broad matrix. Rebar remains stricter by retaining real isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel execution through the production hook in every cell.

## Plan

1. Freeze RED workflow plus build-hook contracts. The workflow oracle rejects GITHUB_SHA, requires git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout, then requires exact equality from installed wheel plus sdist. Build-hook oracles retain env SHA, preserved sdist SHA, git fallback SHA, blank-env failure.
2. Create one shared fixture around checkout-current hatch_build.py plus the src/rebar/_build_info.py boundary. Migrate all whole-tree forms: _clean_tree, _self_contained_checkout, and the inline git archive plus tar extraction in test_hook_fails_when_rebar_build_commit_empty. Re-derive completeness by string-sweeping git archive and tar extraction in build-semantics tests. The direct full-Rebar WheelBuilder content test remains intentional.
3. The fixture creates a tiny Hatch package, copies production hatch_build.py, declares it as the real custom hook, provides src/rebar/__init__.py at the production target, initializes Git, then commits only that tree. The hook writes and force-includes src/rebar/_build_info.py into sdist plus wheel, exercising preserve-existing through the real archive boundary. Default PEP 517 isolation remains; Hatchling, Git, archive creation, and wheel inspection are not mocked.
4. Convert repeated semantics tests in test_attestation_signing.py plus test_build_provenance.py to the fixture. Retain every named assertion, the no-git helper branch, direct full-package content test, and shallow-source control.
5. Keep the full-Rebar replay in shared _artifact-probe.yml, serving test.yml branch-head checkout plus gerrit-verify.yaml patchset checkout. Compute REBAR_EXPECTED_COMMIT using git rev-parse --short HEAD after either final checkout. Build with that value. Require exact equality for wheel plus install-from-sdist. Preserve import, CLI, schema, packaging, and vote-gating probes.
6. Seed the wrong-SHA defect, a whole-tree fixture regression, and one precedence defect. Each oracle must return RED before restoration. Record focused serial plus exact-xdist timings against pre-repair 18.23s selected-six serial and 6.60-6.74s per-worker setup baselines. Timing quantifies runner work but is evidence only, not a retention gate, because host variation dominates wall-clock.
7. Run focused tests, workflow consumers, make lint, typecheck, plus full default/integration selectors. Push immediately through Gerrit without a control-only run. Record hosted macOS plus Ubuntu durations from that treatment.

## Test contract card

authoritative_contract: ducal-statuelike-ladybird requires real sdist-to-wheel provenance, exact env/git fallback, blank-env failure, sdist preservation, plus exact source identity; both workflow consumers must build their final checkout.
trigger_preconditions: each matrix cell runs production hatch_build.py through isolated PEP 517 on the minimal package; artifact-probe has completed its final checkout.
production_path: copied production hatch_build.py resolves, writes, then force-includes COMMIT during sdist plus wheel builds; artifact-probe builds then installs full distributions.
test_tier: minimal real-build probes across every current OS/Python cell plus one full-project artifact integration job per workflow lane.
observable_postcondition: existing semantics remain; full artifacts equal the short SHA of final checkout.
negative_control: wrong nonempty SHA fails; blank env fails; no-git/no-bake remains None; shallow source remains supported.
collateral_invariants: no selector, assertion, isolation mode, worker, platform, Python cell, coverage, mutation, probe, runner, or vote dependency is removed.
ci_gate: focused serial/xdist tests, workflow contracts, make lint, make typecheck, Gerrit Verified, LLM-Review.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every OS/Python cell executes a real isolated sdist-to-wheel build through production hatch_build.py on the minimal fixture.
- [ ] The env-override probe requires the exact supplied SHA.
- [ ] The install-from-sdist probe requires the exact preserved SHA.
- [ ] The git-fallback probe requires the exact committed fixture SHA.
- [ ] The blank-env probe requires a nonzero real-build exit.
- [ ] No hook-semantics test retains _clean_tree, _self_contained_checkout, or inline git-archive materialization.
- [ ] A repository string sweep finds no other full-checkout archive in hook-semantics fixtures.
- [ ] Both artifact workflow lanes derive expected SHA after final checkout.
- [ ] The installed full-Rebar wheel equals expected SHA.
- [ ] The installed full-Rebar sdist equals expected SHA.
- [ ] A wrong nonempty full-artifact SHA fails the workflow oracle.
- [ ] The direct full-Rebar WheelBuilder content test remains enabled.
- [ ] The shallow-source negative control remains enabled.
- [ ] The OS/Python matrix remains unchanged.
- [ ] Pytest selectors, xdist workers, coverage, plus mutation remain unchanged.
- [ ] Artifact import, CLI, schema, plus vote-gating probes remain unchanged.
- [ ] A precedence mutation returns the build-hook oracle to RED.
- [ ] Focused serial plus exact-xdist timings are recorded against the 18.23s serial and 6.60-6.74s per-worker setup baselines as non-gating evidence.
- [ ] The first hosted treatment records macOS plus all Ubuntu job/test durations.
- [ ] Gerrit records LLM-Review +1 before merge.
- [ ] Gerrit records Verified +1 before merge.
- [ ] Gerrit records zero unresolved comments before merge.
